Cover lines 1, 2 and 3 are left completely EMPTY in all three columns, and Form A's printed TOTAL cell is also left empty - so there is no schedule total and no cover line to score the single itemized row against. Reported 'unknown' rather than inventing an anchor. The one corroboration the document does offer is the balance chain (gate d): the ONLY figure printed anywhere on the cover is line 4's CUMULATIVE cell, 571.00, and 0 beginning + 571 contributions - 0 expenditures = 571.00 exactly. Scope recorded 'cumulative' because the two scopes provably coincide here: every LAST-REPORT cell is empty, the certified period is 3/19/2020 to 4/19/2020, and the single row's date 3/19/20 falls inside it, so this is the filer's first report of the cycle and period == cumulative.
